status: Complete 2026-11-09: proved that on the honeycomb torus of side n of rule-60 rings with equally spaced contacts composition is the powers of the six-neighbour sum M = (1 + x)(1 + y/x)(1 + 1/y) over GF(2), that every power vanishes on the three mirror lines through a ring, and that when 3 does not divide n the ring fixed by the turn of 120 degrees about a ring never needs it, so composition never reaches every ring, while from side 7 the mirrors pin no other ring; computed that every ring needs every ring on every side from 3 to 300 divisible by 3, and that otherwise each ring is never needed by exactly 2(N - 1)(N - 2) + 1 rings, N = 2^(v2(n) + 1). Recommendation Research directions (which lattices compose everywhere); the thread moves to the queued epic on which finite maps rescue late rings.
